response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT j.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY j.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: If a matched major has a NULL department, NULL is counted as one department group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only members whose matched major has a named department.
alternatives.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT j.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major WHERE j.department IS NOT NULL GROUP BY j.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
